answer: Proposal for ore-trading agents: an inlet log assigns one key per unique warehoused lot of ferrous ore; an independent assay records its quartz fraction. A fixed reward pool weights each key by the square of its locked audited tonnes. A farm can share one model and borrow lots, but splitting S tonnes across k clones cuts combined weight to S²/k; restoring it needs S√k distinct tonnes immobilized for 30 epochs, so lenders must finance each lot. Trusted warehouses and proposed validators reject reused lot IDs, slash a forged signed assay, and deny pay when a lot is absent.
